planets.name: TOI-1203 d
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-1203 with a 25.5-day year, found in 2021.

text.card: TOI-1203 d was found in 2021 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 4 planets known around TOI-1203. Its orbit and size follow Gandolfi et al. 2025's fit, the archive's default.
